headline: New Jersey would bar nonconsensual AI-generated likeness distribution
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

New Jersey would bar distributing a realistic representation of an individual's image, likeness, or voice created using generative artificial intelligence without consent. Not passed. It cites the fear that anyone can now fake anyone.

116 measures in 32 jurisdictions would create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI or data centers.

28 measures in 18 jurisdictions cite the fear that AI is taking people's personal data.

2,244 measures tracked. 755 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
